Score a hindcast by lead time

Source: R/hindcast.R
hindcast_scores.Rd

Scores each method at each lead time, over every origin. Persistence is the baseline: skill is 1 minus the method's mean squared error over the persistence forecast's, on the same pairs, so 0 means no better than persistence and 1 is perfect. The lead time at which skill falls to zero is where a method stops earning its keep.

Usage

hindcast_scores(hindcast, thresholds = NULL, response_time_h = NULL)

Arguments

hindcast

A pdm_hindcast() result, or a data.table with the same columns (origin, lead_h, method, forecast, observed) from any model, including persistence rows.

thresholds

Optional named vector of threshold flows, m3/s.

response_time_h

Time to peak in hours for lead_ratio; taken from the hindcast if it has one.

Value

A data.table, one row per method and lead time: method, lead_h, lead_ratio, n, nse, rmse, mae, bias (mean forecast minus observed, m3/s), skill, and any threshold scores.

Details

lead_ratio divides the lead time by the model's time to peak, so catchments of different speeds, and different models of the same catchment, line up on one axis.

With thresholds, the step-based contingency scores at each lead time are added as pod:name, far:name and csi:name: at that lead, was the forecast above the threshold when the river was?

Examples

set.seed(1)
n <- 24 * 30
forcing <- data.frame(rain = ifelse(runif(n) < 0.06, rgamma(n, 0.7, scale = 4), 0), pet = 0.05)
observed <- run_pdm(pdm_model(area_km2 = 40, fc = 1.1), forcing)$output$q_m3s
hc <- pdm_hindcast(pdm_model(area_km2 = 40), forcing, observed, horizon_h = 12)
#> The EA 2024 AR default is defined for 15-minute steps; this model uses 1 h steps
scores <- hindcast_scores(hc, thresholds = c(high = 3))
scores[scores$method == "ea_2024" & scores$lead_h %in% c(1, 6, 12), ]
#>     method lead_h lead_ratio     n       nse        rmse         mae
#>     <char>  <num>      <num> <int>     <num>       <num>       <num>
#> 1: ea_2024      1 0.07376612   108 0.9999944 0.003779765 0.001757062
#> 2: ea_2024      6 0.44259672   107 0.9981930 0.067465810 0.029213132
#> 3: ea_2024     12 0.88519343   106 0.9940245 0.122290941 0.064658541
#>            bias     skill  pod:high   far:high  csi:high
#>           <num>     <num>     <num>      <num>     <num>
#> 1: 0.0010178101 0.9969904 1.0000000 0.00000000 1.0000000
#> 2: 0.0009089592 0.9789638 0.9615385 0.03846154 0.9259259
#> 3: 0.0015758778 0.9772074 0.9200000 0.04166667 0.8846154
